events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Defenseman Mattias Samuelsson scored twice and the Buffalo Sabres snapped a five-game skid against the rival Toronto Maple Leafs with a 5-3 victory Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuelsson scores twice and Tuch adds short-handed goal in Sabres' 5-3 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: San Jose Sharks at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Dougie Hamilton scored twice and the New Jersey Devils beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Friday night for their seventh straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hamilton scores 2 power-play goals as Devils beat Sharks 3-1 for 7th straight win

events.name: Washington Capitals at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin scored his 899th career goal and added an assist, and the Washington Capitals beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 3-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin scores 899th goal as Capitals beat Blue Jackets 5-1 for 6th win in 7 games

headlines.description: — Gabriel Vilardi had a goal and assist, backup Eric Comrie made 30 saves and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Calgary Flames 5-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gabriel Vilardi has a goal and assist to help the Jets beat Flames 5-3
